newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain's private sector deposits rises in Q1 97.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain's private sector deposits rises in Q1 97.

text.p: Private sector deposits with commercial banks in Bahrain rose to 1.341 billion dinars ($3.55 billion) in the three months to March 1997 from 1.335 billion on December 31 1996, Bahrain Monetary Agency figures showed.
Public sector deposits for the same period decreased to 481.5 million dinars from 509.9 million.
Total loans and advances extended by commercial banks to residents stood at 951.0 million dinars at the end of March 1997, up from 943.5 million dinars three months earlier.
